sources.entry: Build A Simple Web App With Flask

summary.title: Python Web Applications with Flask
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a basic Flask web app in Python covering routing, URL parameters, Jinja2 templates with a shared layout, and passing random quotes to a page.
takeaways: Install Flask with pip and create a minimal hello.py app that returns text from a route.
Define URL routes such as /hello and /members/<name>/ using @app.route with string parameters.
Separate HTML from Python by putting pages in a templates folder and rendering them with render_template.
Use Jinja2 template inheritance (extends, block) to share a layout.html across pages.
Pass multiple variables to a template, for example by choosing a random quote from a list.
summary.summary: This beginner tutorial walks through building a small web app with the Flask micro-framework in Python. It starts with installing Flask and a Hello World app, then adds URL routes with string parameters, and moves HTML into Jinja2 templates. It shows a shared layout.html with extends and block, and passes a randomly chosen quote into the template. The page mentions connecting to a database as a next step but does not cover it.
